source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to inspect live LeanFrontier state and continue unfinished useful work. After confirming the current open Markov-tree submissions and the already prepared child-label and pairwise-coprimality machinery, GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected a classical arithmetic invariant that can feed later uniqueness work: for an oriented node with Markov-number coordinate M and non-back coordinates u,v, Vieta's product relation gives M dividing u^2+v^2, while pairwise coprimality makes u,v primitive. The module packages the two relevant coprimality statements, proves the divisibility in the oriented-node API, and combines it with Mathlib's sum-of-two-squares modular theorem to prove that -1 is a square modulo |M|. This is a stacked validation candidate because its two direct prerequisites are pending upstream PRs; no claim is made that the open Markov uniqueness conjecture is solved. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and proof architecture and authored all Lean statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
